scope: Declared color usage and input checks; no certification of the rendered design.

checks.instruction: Declared solid-color pair meets its threshold; verify the declared use in the render.
Check the image purpose in this composition; informative images need useful alternatives, decorative images empty alternatives. A filename or catalog description is not a contextual review.
Supply an equivalent text description/transcript with the exported artwork; review reading order and small-screen legibility.
Check the reserved sticker space, destination and copy in Instagram composer before publishing.
